mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_visit (student_id, teacher_id, visit_time, visit_content, next_visit_time, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{teacherId}, #{visitTime}, #{visitContent}, #{nextVisitTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE student_visit SET visit_time = #{visitTime}, visit_content = #{visitContent}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT sv.*, es.student_name, es.student_code, es.phone, st.tag_type, st.on_time_rate FROM student_visit sv LEFT JOIN edu_student es ON es.id = sv.student_id LEFT JOIN student_tag st ON st.student_id = sv.student_id WHERE sv.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND sv.next_visit_time <= #{today} AND sv.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY sv.next_visit_time ASC
SELECT * FROM student_visit WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY next_visit_time DESC LIMIT 1
